profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Designing End-to-End LLM Agent Systems, API Frameworks & Reliable Data Pipelines at Scale
profile.summary: I'm a dedicated technology enthusiast with 8+ years of software engineering experience, spanning API architecture, complex migrations, and seamless user experiences. I've led teams and collaborated on projects, leveraging technologies such as Spring Boot and AWS Lambdas. Passionate about innovation, I engineer solutions that optimize efficiency, enhance user satisfaction, and drive digital evolution. My insatiable curiosity for emerging technology fuels my ongoing learning journey. Let's connect and explore how our paths align!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Summary of Role & Impact
Technical lead engineer on Mapbox’s Traffic & Incident Data team, driving the redesign of our real-time road incident and closure pipelines. Day-to-day, I focus on building AI agent infrastructure, tool-calling frameworks, and backend systems on AWS to ingest and deliver clean spatial data to millions of drivers and enterprise clients.

Key Accomplishments & Responsibilities
• Agent Infrastructure & SDK Development: Led the design and development of a multi-agent system from scratch to fix global data coverage gaps. Prototyped the initial POC, built consensus across the team, and brought it to production using the Claude Agent SDK and CrewAI. Built the framework to let agents dynamically call, authenticate with, and parse responses from thousands of unique external APIs into our internal schema.
• Context Architecture & Function Calling: Solved reliability issues around non-deterministic model outputs by refining prompt design, context windows, and tool schemas. Made the pipeline resilient enough to handle widely varying API payloads and edge cases without breaking downstream flows.
• Evals & Quality Measurement: Set up tracing and evaluation suites to benchmark agent accuracy, flag schema regressions, and test context strategies before shipping updates to production pipelines.
• Core System Overhaul & Traceability: Architected a ground-up redesign of our core incident processing engine to establish full data lineage across the pipeline lifecycle. Provided the foundation needed to write far better deduplication and conflation logic for high-volume data feeds.
• Cross-Functional & Client Technical Lead: Partnered with our Maps and Tiling teams to route enriched traffic data directly into map tiles. Maintained client-facing integrations and served as the technical point of contact for enterprise feature requests.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Docker

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led migration from a Python monolith to AWS-based Node.js lambda functions, enhancing scalability and error-handling efficiency.
• Architected GraphQL implementation, optimizing data retrieval and reducing backend API calls, improving client-server interaction.
• Collaborated with Transunion and Experian, integrating credit background check APIs for reliability and failover capability.
• Designed foundational architecture, enabling future microservices extraction and system scalability.
• Advocated for GraphQL adoption, improving data request efficiency and streamlining backend responses.
• Redesigned critical applications page, reducing latency and load times by efficient data aggregation.
• Employed technology stack: GraphQL, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Django.
positions.insights: Skills: Reliability · Apollo GraphQL · Django REST Framework · TypeScript · Node.js · typescript · Python (Programming Language) · Code Review

positions.title: L6
positions.description:
• Engineered a versatile library, enabling rapid service setup with reusable modules like monitoring, error handling, and DB connections. Enhanced developer efficiency and maintained consistent architecture, allowing teams to focus on core business logic.
• As the lead for system design documentation, I mentored junior engineers, guiding them through NestJS adoption and emphasizing effective data flow and cross-team collaboration. This fostered a cohesive development process and empowered engineers to contribute effectively.
• I played a pivotal role in architecting essential services:
          - CMA Management: Developed a robust service for creating and managing Comparative Market Analyses (CMAs), a cornerstone of Better.com's real estate operations.
          - Automated Home Tours: Streamlined tour scheduling and smart lock communication, optimizing user experiences and operational efficiency. Integration with Google Calendar APIs enhanced real estate processes.
          - Notification Preferences: Engineered a service to optimize customer notifications, leveraging cached preferences and automated daily cron jobs for seamless delivery, ultimately enhancing user engagement.
• At the forefront of adopting federated GraphQL, I closely collaborated with a lead engineer, initiated educational Lunch and Learn sessions, and orchestrated the creation of a complex federated supergraph. This innovative approach ensured coherent data exchange across services while maintaining robust data integrity.
• My dedication to cross-team collaboration led to the optimization of data exchange mechanisms. By leveraging GraphQL federation, REST APIs, and event buses, I established a cohesive data ecosystem that seamlessly integrated with multiple internal teams, enhancing communication and streamlining processes.
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · Apache Kafka · Reliability · Data Caching · Apollo GraphQL · Systems Design · python · TypeScript · Redis · PostgreSQL · Code Review

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the migration of 8-10 legacy APIs, enhancing latency using Spring Boot and AWS Lambdas.  
• Collaborated with the lead architect to align microservices architecture with MVP requirements.  
• Refactored legacy code with Java streams, improving efficiency and reducing costs.  
• Successfully orchestrated an 8-month migration, ensuring seamless production deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apache Kafka · Reliability · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Code Review · Microservices · AWS Lambda · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a Customer Experience Team to enhance the customer journey through innovative technology solutions.  
• Designed and implemented an Android application for seamless player management and food ordering.  
• Developed multiple HTTP REST clients and backend services using Ktor and Micronaut frameworks.  
• Engineered intuitive UIs with React for efficient event management and troubleshooting.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Reliability · Kubernetes · React.js · TypeScript · Android · Code Review · RabbitMQ

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a dedicated team in developing a custom HTML rendering platform to enhance the Paint Experience for millions.  
• Pioneered the architecture of APIs connecting customers to the www.homedepot.com/color platform.  
• Spearheaded the creation of a React App, optimizing user interaction and engagement.  
• Contributed to a Hackathon initiative, developing a Home Depot button for easy reordering of products.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the Cart and Checkout team within the .com department at The Home Depot.  
• Developed RESTful Web Services using Spring applications to facilitate communication between front-end and APIs.  
• Contributed to the transition from WCS e-commerce system to custom in-house APIs and orchestration layers.

positions.title: Entry Level Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented JUnit Testing for the Checkout section of The Home Depot's .com department, enhancing code reliability.  
• Integrated JMeter to conduct concurrency tests on production and controller commands, ensuring system performance under load.  
• Gained foundational knowledge of WCS e-commerce Systems, contributing to a better understanding of online retail operations.
